data.case_title: Payment reminder from Schlüsseldienst Beispielriegel for locksmith invoice
data.title: Payment reminder: locksmith invoice of €148.75 due 9 December 2026
data.summary: Schlüsseldienst Beispielriegel sent a payment reminder (Zahlungserinnerung) for their invoice dated 27 October 2026, covering an emergency door opening and lock cylinder replacement carried out on 26 October 2026. They ask for the outstanding amount of €148.75 to be paid by Wednesday, 9 December 2026.
data.explanation: A locksmith you hired to open your locked apartment door and replace the cylinder lock is reminding you that their invoice of €148.75 is still unpaid. Pay the amount to the IBAN shown by the stated due date to avoid further reminders or late fees. If you already paid, keep your proof of payment ready in case they contact you again. This kind of tradesperson service (Handwerkerleistung) may be partly deductible on your German tax return if paid by bank transfer, so keep the invoice and this reminder for your records.
data.tax_note: Labor costs for tradesperson services (Handwerkerleistungen) such as a locksmith opening a door and replacing a lock can be partly deductible under §35a EStG if paid by bank transfer (not cash); keep the original invoice and proof of transfer.
